Your holdings: SOXL is a SELL/TRIM candidate, down 47.74%. SPAL is also a SELL/TRIM, down 44.61%. Both are leveraged ETFs and decay is a major concern, especially on margin.

Watch: Keep an eye on SMH, currently down 9.97%. It's a key semiconductor ETF.

Bottom line: Focus on managing your leveraged positions and watching the semiconductor sector.
plays: SOXL: Consider trimming or exiting this leveraged position given the significant drawdown and decay risk.
SPAL: Similar to SOXL, evaluate trimming or exiting this leveraged ETF due to its large loss and decay.
SMH: Monitor this semiconductor ETF closely; a further drop could signal broader sector weakness.
